trigger: Physical Windows pilot shortcut launched installed scripts/one_click_home_local.ps1 without installed-mode arguments and failed while searching for scripts/install_home_local.ps1 inside the installed runtime.
purpose: Make clean install, upgrade, repaired installation, desktop shortcut, START_QUANTUM.cmd and direct installed-script launch converge on the same verified installed-runtime path without treating an installed runtime as an installation package.

requirements.requirement: Direct execution of the installed one_click_home_local.ps1 must automatically detect a complete installed runtime and must not search for install_home_local.ps1.
requirements.test: Install to a temporary Windows path and invoke installed scripts/one_click_home_local.ps1 with -InstallOnly and no PackageRoot, InstalledRoot or SkipInstall arguments.
requirements.pass_criterion: Exit code 0 and no INSTALLER_PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND-style failure.

requirements.requirement: START_QUANTUM.cmd must pass a canonical installed root without a trailing-backslash quoting ambiguity and must forward optional test arguments.
requirements.test: Invoke START_QUANTUM.cmd -InstallOnly -NoOpenResult from paths containing spaces and Cyrillic characters.
requirements.pass_criterion: Installed mode is selected and the runtime self-check completes.

requirements.requirement: Installation or repair must replace stale user and common-desktop Quantum shortcuts with a verified shortcut targeting START_QUANTUM.cmd in the current installation root.
requirements.test: Seed stale shortcuts targeting one_click_home_local.ps1 or an obsolete root, reinstall, then inspect TargetPath and WorkingDirectory through WScript.Shell.
requirements.pass_criterion: Exactly the current START_QUANTUM.cmd target is used and direct-script stale targets are removed.

requirements.requirement: A partial or damaged installed runtime must fail with an explicit repair-required diagnostic and must never be misclassified as a source package.
requirements.test: Remove one required installed component and invoke the installed launcher.
requirements.pass_criterion: Fail-closed HOME_LOCAL_INSTALLATION_INCOMPLETE diagnostic identifies missing components; config, data and output remain unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Upgrade over the previous XNF1 installation must atomically replace launch surfaces while preserving user config, data and output.
requirements.test: Install old-layout fixture, create sentinel user files, run replacement installer, verify launch and sentinels.
requirements.pass_criterion: Launcher paths are repaired and all user sentinels retain identical SHA-256.

requirements.requirement: The one-click EXE built from the corrected exact head must pass clean-install, upgrade, shortcut, CMD, direct-script, installed-runtime, bundle and native self-test gates on Windows.
requirements.test: Exact-head Windows workflow and installer workflow.
requirements.pass_criterion: Downloadable EXE with exact SHA-256 and zero open reproducible P0/P1 defects.
